resolve.notInFulfillmentForDesigner: Order hasn't entered fulfillment yet — this error can't be pushed back to Designer.
resolve.cannotPushBack: Cannot push back to "{{target}}" — order is currently at "{{current}}".

page.descStage: Scan the ORDER barcode → scan the OK code next to complete, or scan an error QR to report + auto push back. No need to touch the computer.
page.descGeneric: Plug in the USB scanner → scan the ORDER barcode to open the error dialog (scan an error QR next to assign quickly).
page.scanOrderFirst: Scan the ORDER code first, then scan the OK code / error code.
page.notFound: No order found with this code
page.placeholderManual: Enter Production ID then press Enter…
page.prefixMissingWarning: ⚠ prefix "{{prefix}}" not detected — make sure you're scanning the right barcode type
page.tipBarcode: Tip: the USB scanner acts like a keyboard — just keep the input focused, code "{{prefix}}…" will be typed in automatically followed by Enter. The system strips the prefix before looking up.
page.tipManual: Tip: enter the full Production ID (no prefix) then press Enter to look up.
page.emptyHistory: No scans yet. Scan or type a Production ID to get started.

fulfillmentDialog.blockDifferentFactory: This order belongs to another factory — you cannot act on it.
fulfillmentDialog.blockAlreadyDone: You have already completed this stage for this order.
fulfillmentDialog.blockNotInFulfillment: Order hasn't entered the fulfillment process yet.
fulfillmentDialog.blockWrongStage: Order is currently at stage "{{stage}}", not your stage.
fulfillmentDialog.blockNotOperable: Order is not in an actionable state.
fulfillmentDialog.errorNotInStage: Error code doesn't belong to stage "{{stage}}" — check the station's QR board.
fulfillmentDialog.reportOnlyOnScanPage: Reporting errors via scan is only available on the Scan Code page.
fulfillmentDialog.closeDialogFirst: Close the dialog then scan the order in the lookup field.
fulfillmentDialog.clickToOpenOriginal: Click to open the original image
fulfillmentDialog.bannerInProgress: Order is In progress — this is your stage, use the scanner following 3 steps:
fulfillmentDialog.bannerStatus: Order is {{status}} — this is your stage, use the scanner following 3 steps:
fulfillmentDialog.completeStepTitle: DONE → scan the order code AGAIN (or scan "OK")
fulfillmentDialog.completeStepDesc: Scan this order's barcode again — the order completes this stage and automatically moves to the next one. Scanning the OK code or pressing Enter also works.
fulfillmentDialog.errorStep1Title: Scan the error QR on the board
fulfillmentDialog.errorStep1Desc: The error is SELECTED (not yet recorded) — type a description or scan another code to change it.
fulfillmentDialog.errorStep2Title: Scan the SAME code again to confirm
fulfillmentDialog.errorStep2Desc: The error is now recorded + the order is automatically pushed back according to config.
fulfillmentDialog.zoneReportThisOrder: ⚠ Report error for this order — scan twice
fulfillmentDialog.farErrorStep1Desc: The error is SELECTED (not yet recorded) — open the error assignment screen to review.
fulfillmentDialog.farErrorStep2Desc: Records the error + automatically pushes the order back to the configured stage.
fulfillmentDialog.continueScanDesc: Switch to looking up a new order, or press Enter to close and continue scanning.

orderErrorDialog.orderCancelled: Order is cancelled — cannot report an error.
orderErrorDialog.errorNotInStage: Error code doesn't belong to stage "{{stage}}" — check the station's QR board.
orderErrorDialog.noStageContext: Stage not yet determined — error codes are not accepted via scan.
orderErrorDialog.selectedError: Selected error "{{name}}" — scan the SAME code again or press Enter to record it.
orderErrorDialog.closeDialogFirst: Close the dialog then scan the order in the lookup field.
orderErrorDialog.okOnlyForWorker: The OK code is only for stage workers — scan an error QR here instead.
orderErrorDialog.clickToOpenOriginal: Click to open the original image
orderErrorDialog.zoneHowToReport: How to report an error — scan twice
orderErrorDialog.step1Desc: Or tap to select a code below — source & push-back destination follow config automatically.
orderErrorDialog.step2Desc: Picked the wrong one? Scan a DIFFERENT code to change the selection.
orderErrorDialog.step3Title: Scan the SAME code again / Enter
orderErrorDialog.step3Desc: The error is now recorded + the order is automatically pushed back.
orderErrorDialog.cancelledTitle: Order is cancelled — cannot report an error
orderErrorDialog.cancelledDesc: The cancelled order has left every stage, it cannot be pushed back to a previous stage.
orderErrorDialog.existingErrorTitle: Error already recorded on this order
orderErrorDialog.noErrorsInStage: Stage "{{stage}}" has no errors in the catalog yet.
orderErrorDialog.noStageNoErrors: Order hasn't entered fulfillment and you have no stage — the error catalog can't be determined.
orderErrorDialog.addErrorForStage: Add an error for this stage
orderErrorDialog.resolutionHint: Automatic according to the error catalog config. Scan the SAME CODE again (or press Enter) to record it — scan a different code to change the selection, type a description below if needed.
